name: TetraSDF Training Procedure
definition: Optimizes a neural network to represent a signed distance field (SDF) using a multi-resolution tetrahedral grid, combining L1 regression, Eikonal regularization, and weight normalization constraints.
summary: TetraSDF Training optimizes a neural network using a tetrahedral grid for efficient multi-resolution signed distance field representation, distinguishing itself from standard MLP methods through specific mesh extraction capabilities.
